pr_title: Fix NPE thrown by prefix and regex query in strange scenarios
pr_body:
In certain scenarios, running a MultiTerm query sets a `null` rewrite method. While `null` is usually checked, there are branches in the code where this is not adequately checked.

Additionally, `MultiTermQuery#setRewriteMethod` has been deprecated for a while. So, to correct this bug, 

 - Remove calls to `MultiTermQuery#setRewriteMethod` where possible
 - Always check for `null` rewrite method


closes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/94364
pr_comments: Hi @benwtrent, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

> Are there still some places left that call `setRewriteMethod()` after this change?

Two places: 

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/c513b2bcc68bf730aef5a13cf36737c4b38d713f/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/query/FuzzyQueryBuilder.java#L337-L338

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/edd7749164aa6873a0eb7565abcc612d29c601f0/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/search/MatchQueryParser.java#L477-L480

Those two places seemed really weird to me. 

I think we could get around them by adding `RewriteMethod` as a parameter to `FieldType#fuzzyQuery` but that was even a bigger change. If you think that is good, I will happily do it.

> Can you add a test for the specific scenario that's failing in that test report? It's a bit alarming that we don't already cover it.

Oh yeah, I am working on a test now. Wanted to get your opinion on the current fix.

> I think we could get around them by adding RewriteMethod as a parameter to FieldType#fuzzyQuery but that was even a bigger change. If you think that is good, I will happily do it.

Let's do it.  And +1 to the direction of the PR in general.

issue_context.title: Error when doing a prefix search when the prefix is min_chars -1

review_comments: This should probably pass `this.fuzzyRewriteMethod` shouldn't it? But I guess that's a behaviour change - maybe add a TODO and we can call it out separately as a bugfix?

OK, looking at `QueryParserBase#getFuzzyQuery` (the thing this class overrides), Lucene doesn't set the `fuzzyRewriteMethod` there either. 

Do we want to do that here? I am honestly not sure.
I should probably go deprecate this in lucene as well, just for consistency.  For a follow-up.
